# `lakana runs`

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_reference.py from the Typer app. Do not edit by hand:
run `uv run python scripts/generate_reference.py` and commit the result. -->

Part of the [Command line reference](../cli.md), which lists the options for every command.

Usage: `lakana runs [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...`

Runs of deployed project versions.

## `lakana runs list`

Usage: `lakana runs list [OPTIONS]`

List runs, newest first.

A long list prints a "More results" line with the command that shows the next page.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--env` | text | none | Environment (default: the profile's). |
| `--repo` | text | none | Only this repository. |
| `--status` | text, repeatable | none | Only runs in this status: queued, running, succeeded, failed or cancelled. Repeat the option or separate the values with commas. |
| `--trigger` | text, repeatable | none | Only runs started this way: schedule, api, manual or deploy. Repeat the option or separate the values with commas. |
| `--job` | text | none | Only runs of this job. |
| `--since` | text | none | Only runs created at or after this date or time, such as 2026-10-18 or 2026-10-18T09:30:00Z. Without a time zone it is read in yours. |
| `--limit` | whole number, 1 to 200 | none | Most runs to list (default 100). |
| `--cursor` | text | none | Continue after the page that printed this cursor. |

## `lakana runs show`

Usage: `lakana runs show [OPTIONS] {run_id}`

Show run RUN_ID, its tasks and its notifications; waiting_for says why a task waits.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `RUN_ID` | text | required |  |
| `--env` | text | none | Environment (default: the profile's). |

## `lakana runs logs`

Usage: `lakana runs logs [OPTIONS] {run_id}`

Print a run's task logs.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `RUN_ID` | text | required |  |
| `--env` | text | none | Environment (default: the profile's). |
| `--task` | text | none | Only this task's log. |
| `--follow` | flag | off | Keep printing new text until the run finishes; each byte is fetched once. |

## `lakana runs cancel`

Usage: `lakana runs cancel [OPTIONS] {run_id}`

Request cancellation of RUN_ID.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `RUN_ID` | text | required |  |
| `--env` | text | none | Environment (default: the profile's). |

## `lakana runs resume`

Usage: `lakana runs resume [OPTIONS] {run_id}`

Resume RUN_ID's failed, upstream_failed and cancelled tasks in a new run.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `RUN_ID` | text | required |  |
| `--env` | text | none | Environment (default: the profile's). |
